summary: 1–3, Lyman Sherman is forgiven of his sins; 4–5, He is to be numbered with the leading elders of the Church; 6–8, He is called to preach the gospel and strengthen his brethren.
meta_description: Revelation given through Joseph Smith the Prophet, at Kirtland, Ohio, December 26, 1835. This section was received at the request of Lyman Sherman, who had previously been ordained one of the seven presidents of the Seventy and who had come to the Prophet with a request for a revelation to make known his duty.
